journey.name: usdt bridge amount errors
journey.description: Use an onboarded USDT wallet and a gateway fixture that rejects outbound quotes and inbound estimates with xchain_amount_too_small. No payment is submitted. The error describes live bridge costs rather than inventing a fixed network minimum.

actions.action: Open USDT Send, select Tron and enter a valid external Tron address. Enter 3.5 USDT and continue. Verify the amount screen remains visible, payment review does not open, and the error says Amount too small to cover bridge costs. Try a larger amount.

Return to USDT Receive, select Tron and enter an expected deposit amount of 3.5 USDT. Continue. Verify the same actionable error is shown and no deposit QR is presented. Verify the error does not claim that the provider's advertised minimum guarantees acceptance.
Change the fixture to provide a valid quote or estimate, increase the amount and continue. Verify the error clears and the flow advances. Stop before approving a payment or sharing a deposit request.
